choices: The Lord blessed the Egyptian's house for Joseph's sake
questions.explain: The Most High gives His people compassion before them who carried them captive (1 Kings 8:50).

questions.q: What did Joseph say to his master's wife?
choices: How then can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God?
questions.explain: Adultery was known as sin from the beginning, long before Sinai.

questions.q: What example does Joseph leaving his garment and fleeing give?
choices: Never work in a rich house
Flee from sin as from the face of a serpent
questions.explain: If thou comest too near it, it will bite thee (Ecclesiasticus 21:1-2).

questions.q: Why could no plea reach Potiphar?
choices: Jealousy is the rage of a man; he will not spare in the day of vengeance
